name: Haroe
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Haroe (also called Reaiah) is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as a descendant of Judah through Shobal. He belongs to the lineage of Kiriath-jearim and is part of the genealogical lists that connect the tribe of Judah with important cities and families in Israel.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Judah
keyEvents.description: Haroe is listed as a son of Shobal in the genealogical record of Judah and is linked to the founders of Kiriath-jearim.

keyEvents.title: Identified as Reaiah
keyEvents.description: Haroe is also mentioned by the name Reaiah in a parallel genealogy in 1 Chronicles, as a son of Shobal.

keyEvents.title: Connection to Hur's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Through his father Shobal, Haroe is connected to Hur, who was the firstborn son of Ephrathah and a prominent figure in the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Connection to Kiriath-jearim
keyEvents.description: Haroe belongs to the lineage that founded and populated Kiriath-jearim, an important city where the ark of the covenant was kept for a time.
